items.title: US Stock Market Today: S&P 500 Futures Edge Up As Traders Eye Key CPI
items.summary: The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Thursday, Aug, 13 2026 US stock futures are pointing slightly higher this morning, with E-mini S&P 500 contracts up about 0.2% and Nasdaq-100 futures ahead by roughly 0.6%, as investors focus on a key inflation update and what it could mean for interest rates. items.title: S&P 500 Medical Stocks: Three Trade Near Buy Points; One Rallies Despite Mixed Results
items.summary: S&P 500 drug distributor Cardinal Health easily topped fiscal fourth-quarter earnings forecasts despite a revenue shortfall.  Rival McKesson, which whipsawed after its earnings report last week, has climbed back near a buy point.  Cencora, another big S&P 500 drug distributor, also is near a buy point, but MCK stock may be the strongest of the three.
